extracted.intended_audience: NASA/JSC propulsion & power engineers, contractor refurbishment teams (Ball Aerospace), PRSA test/QA personnel
extracted.subtask_description: Refurbishment, acceptance testing, and documentation of PRSA liquid hydrogen (H2) and liquid oxygen (O2) Design Verification and Test (DVT) tank assemblies so they function as flight-like engineering test articles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet functional requirements of RI procurement specifications
rubrics_metrics.description: The configuration of the tanks following refurbishment meets the functional requirements of RI P/N MC282-0112-0200M for the H2 DVT and RI P/N MC282-0112-0100Pl for the O2 DVT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refurbished tanks must be configured to satisfy the cited RI part numbers' functional requirements; verify configuration against those specification documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use latest revision drawings, specifications, and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: All drawings, specifications, and procedures used were of the latest revision utilized under the OV-105 PRSA tank production program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Updates to these documents shall be effected as red-lines and collected in BECD Modification Drawings (e.g., 163502, 163504, 163506) and included in the End Item Acceptance Data Package (EIAD).

rubrics_metrics.name: End Item Acceptance Testing (EIAT) to latest procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: End Item Acceptance Testing shall be performed to the latest revision of the EIAT procedure (e.g., H2 DVT - BECD drawing 163414, revision N; O2 DVT - BECD drawing 163461, revision J).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If physical differences (e.g., shorter quantity gauge probe) exist, EIAT procedures may be redlined to correct expected outputs; testing must be completed without incident and documented in EIAD.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signal conditioner output accuracy requirement (±2% full scale)
rubrics_metrics.description: Signal Conditioner System Output must be within ±2% of full scale accuracy (±0.100 Vdc).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EIAT measurement tables (e.g., Table B.1) must show outputs within this tolerance; if a redline correction is required (shorter probe), document corrected values and confirm compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Component Acceptance Test (CAT) for LRUs
rubrics_metrics.description: Signal Conditioner Assemblies and similar line-replaceable units (LRUs) are to be CAT tested (e.g., procedure 163406) and only refurbished if CAT indicates refurbishment is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If CAT passes, the unit may be reused without refurbishment; track serial numbers (S/N) to ensure correct units are installed on correct tanks and record CAT results in EIAD.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of MRB-dispositioned and approved source hardware
rubrics_metrics.description: Technical requirements included the use of MRB dispositioned (usable for engineering test) hardware, remaining SHT0005 components, and residual hardware from Orbiter and EDO programs; no NSTS program hardware required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document all reused vs. replaced hardware in an As-Built Configuration Record (ABCR) included in the EIAD; list major components replaced or reused in tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not open pressure vessel unless specified (Neck Plug policy)
rubrics_metrics.description: As recommended in the proposal, the Neck Plug was not removed on either tank and, therefore, the Pressure Vessel was not opened.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the pressure vessel is not opened, internal components are reused; document that policy decision and any consequences (e.g., short quantity gauge probe) in the report and EIAD.

rubrics_metrics.name: External Multilayer Insulation (MLI) Blanket fabrication specification
rubrics_metrics.description: An External MLI Blanket was designed and fabricated using 25 layers of 0.25 double aluminized mylar (BMS 17.15, Type XXVII), netting (BMS 17.22, Type I) as the MLI, a Beta Cloth exterior, and Velcro® for assembly of the two pieces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliver the blanket per the spec and ship with the tank; include design/fabrication records in EIAD and note shipment date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide mating mechanical and electrical connectors with EIAT fixtures
rubrics_metrics.description: All mating mechanical and electrical connectors required to interface with the H2 and O2 DVT were packaged with the EIAT Test Fixtures which were shipped concurrently with the tanks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a connector parts list (part numbers, names, quantities) packaged with EIAT fixtures; verify connector compatibility during EIAT.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide End-Item Acceptance Test fixtures for each tank
rubrics_metrics.description: One H2 EIAT fixture (tool number T7479265) and one O2 EIAT fixture (tool number T7479264) shall be fabricated and shipped with the respective tanks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure fixtures are fabricated per spec, packaged, and shipped concurrently; include tooling numbers and shipment records in EIAD.

rubrics_metrics.name: Safety, reliability, and quality assurance compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Safety, reliability, and quality assurance requirements for the O2 and H2 DVT are as specified in the PRSA Quality Assurance Control Plan (CR0009-1037) and PRSA Quality Work Instructions (QWI No. 2772).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the QA control plan and QWIs during refurbishment and testing; include QA records and MRB analyses in EIAD.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heater element insulation resistance minimum and recovery target
rubrics_metrics.description: Heater element insulation resistance initially must meet or exceed 500 Meg-ohms requirement; engineering required that the insulation resistance value far exceed 500 Meg-ohms to ensure repeat 'sudden insulation resistance drop-offs' did not occur.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If insulation resistance is low due to moisture, use externally applied heat, heater activation, and pump-purge cycles with helium to dry leads; monitor recovery over time (example: gradual improvement over 38 days of vacuum) and document curve (e.g., J2 Heater Element Recovery History).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vacuum acquisition and vacuum annulus cleanliness criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Vacuum decay data are a measure of the cleanliness and integrity of the vacuum annulus. After cool-down and before pinch-off, isolate annulus and monitor pressure: the slower the rate of pressure change and the lower the pressure after four hours, the better the integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For flight builds, take data at one-hour increments for four hours. To improve vacuum acquisition, perform numerous pneumatic sweeps using dry GN2 followed by vacuum pumpdown cycles; document vacuum decay curves and compare with baseline tanks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vacuum maintenance schedule recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: BECD recommends that vacuum maintenance of the tanks' vacuum annulus be performed every 30 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedule regular vacuum maintenance and document maintenance dates and results in tank records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document pressure time and cycle history and inform future users
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain and deliver up-to-date records of the pressure time and cycle histories; future users should be made aware of the total number of pressure vessel cycles performed to date and continue to maintain records of additional pressure cycles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide tabulated pressure time and cycle histories (e.g., Tables C.1 and C.2); note accuracy caveats (some data may be memory-based ~95% accurate) and assumptions (BECD interpretation of design life—300 cycles equates to mission equivalents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Design life and cycle-count assumptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Approximate total cycles interpretation: H2 DVT ~ one-third of design life of 300 cycles (assuming 300 cycles ≡ 100 missions and ambient/cryogenic cycles equally stressful); O2 DVT ~ one-fourth of design life of 300 cycles under same assumptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State assumptions used to interpret cumulative cycles and include them when communicating remaining useful life estimates to users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electrical deviation handling (heater resistance, probe capacitance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-existing deviations such as higher-than-specified heater resistance or slightly different quantity gauge probe capacitance that do not compromise intended function may be accepted with compensating measures (e.g., increase bus voltage for heater element).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure deviations, assess functional impact, propose compensations (e.g., operate heater No.2 at higher bus voltage), secure concurrence from customer (e.g., NASA JSC), and document decision and rationale in EIAD.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proof pressure verification
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain events require proof pressure verification (examples from tables: proof pressure of 365 psia for 3 minutes for H2 entries; 1155 psia for 3 minutes for O2 entries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform and record proof pressure tests where specified; include date, duration, and pressure in cycle history tables and EIAD.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide complete EIAD package (EIAT data, MRB analyses, documentation)
rubrics_metrics.description: BECD Configuration and Data Management assembled and provided all EIAT data, MRB analyses, and other necessary documentation in their respective End Item Acceptance Data-Packages (EIAD).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliver EIAD with the tank shipment and include ABCR, EIAT results, CAT results, MRB paperwork, modification drawings, red-lines, and any other relevant technical records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) and master schedule; document authorized changes
rubrics_metrics.description: The WBS and the contract baseline were established and the PRSA Master schedule depicts top-level activities; the baseline plan should reflect authorized changes and progress against WBS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establish second-level WBS, maintain master schedule (e.g., Figures A.1–A.3) and note authorized contract changes on the schedule; provide schedule updates to stakeholders and include in program records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Girth ring replacement decision rationale
rubrics_metrics.description: Replace or reuse girth ring based on engineering/materials review; e.g., replacement with a new girth ring from SHT0005 was chosen to 'limit the opportunities to damage wires.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document analyses, rationale, and concurrence from Program Administration and Materials & Processes Engineering for decisions that affect assembly integrity; include supporting correspondence in EIAD.
